card.name: US federal statute names and citations
card.fires_on: Words that finish a reference to a US federal law, such as Public Law numbers, the IDEA or ESA acronyms, or 'into law'. It appears in policy and legal web text.

modes.label: Public Law citation
modes.description: The 'Law' or '.L' in a Public Law (P.L.) citation before the number.

modes.label: Act acronym
modes.description: The last letter or letters of an acronym for a federal act, such as IDEA or ESA.
modes.example: the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDE<<A>>)--requires

modes.label: Becoming law
modes.description: Words about a bill being signed or becoming law.
modes.example: bill signed<< into>> law by President Obama
